A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] worked on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] as a '''power generator engineer'''. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in an [[Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid/Legends|attack]] on the [[Central power distribution grid/Legends|Coruscant power generator]].

==Biography==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], a debate raged in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] on whether to deregulate the banks to finance the production of more [[Clone trooper/Legends|clones]] or not. In a bid to sway the votes in their favor, [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]], [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] tasked his [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], to transfer his [[Infiltrator/Demolition droid|demolition droids]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to [[Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid/Legends|blow up]] the [[Central power distribution grid/Legends|power generator]] and scare the [[Senator/Legends|senators]] into voting for deregulation. The engineer was present when the droids attacked the compound. As the droids infiltrated the area, the engineer ducked under his work table while the rest of [[Coruscant power generator engineer/Legends|his colleagues]] were massacred. While he hid, he found a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] strapped to the underside of the table. He picked it up and fired at one of the large droids, but due to their heavy armor, the [[Amban phase-pulse blaster|blaster]] had no effect. The engineer was then quickly [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the droid he had fired upon. When the droids blew up the generator, his body, along with his colleagues was consumed by the flames.

==Personality and traits==
When the droids attacked, the engineer was quick enough to hide under the desk while the rest of his colleagues were murdered. When he found a [[Weequay blaster pistol/Legends|Weequay blaster pistol]] there, he did not hesitate to challenge the droids openly despite the fact that he was heavily outnumbered.
